headline: OpenAI releases 722 AI-generated mathematics manuscripts across 372 result families with partial Lean formalization
summary: On October 6, OpenAI published a GitHub collection of mathematical manuscripts generated by an internal frontier model, alongside some Lean formalizations and process details. The repository README reports 722 manuscripts across 372 families and approximately 4,000 attempted problems. OpenAI says not all results are formalized and some unformalized work may contain errors. An independent mathematics advisory group calls the release an important first step, while saying mathematical assessment and human understanding remain to be done.
